diagram_math_checks.justification: These are the inclusion/quotient maps for the nested A-submodules in step 2.1, with the graded object explicitly defined as F_k/F_{k-1}. There is no asserted commutative square or additional splitting.

diagram_math_checks.graded_action: On the length-k quotient f sends N_w tensor v to N_w tensor w^{-1}(f)v; lower-length corrections vanish. A weight t therefore becomes w t, with the convention (w t)(ell)=t(w^{-1}ell).
